Instructions for Use
Device description: The Garnet Neurostimulation System is a spinal cord stimulation system. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
The Garnet Neurostimulation System is MR Conditional. Scanning is possible under the conditions in the table below.
Static magnetic field strength: 1.5 T or 3.0 T
Parameter 1.5 T 3 T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 1,000 gauss/cm
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode or First Level Controlled Operating Mode
RF Transmit Coil Type Body transmit coil or head transmit coil
B1+rms ≤ 1.2 μT
Whole-Body SAR ≤ 4 W/kg
Head SAR ≤ 3.2 W/kg
Maximum active scan time 30 minutes
Whole-body SAR limits apply only to MR scanners that do not report B1+rms.
Device Configuration MRI SureScan mode
